video.title: Once You Get Money, Buy These 10 Things Immediately

summary: Codie Sanchez gives advice on spending money to buy back time, improve work and personal life, and build useful skills. She discusses hiring help, paying for proximity, food, sleep, tax advice, and selected appearance upgrades, with examples of prices and productivity claims. The video describes many services and products but does not develop a single business as its main subject. It also promotes a free owner event and includes an Eight Sleep discount link.

tactics.name: Calculate a buyback rate before delegating
steps: Divide net income by annual hours worked to estimate hourly income.
Halve the hourly income to set a buyback rate.
Compare the cost of a task with that rate before deciding whether to delegate.

quote.text: If I can actually pay someone less than half of what my hour is worth to take a task off my plate, I usually should.
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

tactics.name: Use one premium wardrobe item and replace worn clothes
steps: Choose one high-quality item to wear consistently.
Remove three worn or ill-fitting closet items and replace them.
When adding something new, consider getting rid of something else.

quote.text: If I'm going to bring anything new, I usually get rid of something else.
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

tactics.name: Pay for proximity to useful people
steps: Reduce time spent commuting where possible.
Choose a gym, coworking space, or peer group where relevant people spend time.
Treat access to a network as an input to income rather than an incidental benefit.

quote.text: Your network is a measurable input to your income.
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

tactics.name: Price the cost of exiting before committing
steps: Before signing a lease, contractor agreement, or vendor contract, ask what it costs to walk away.
Set aside the exit cost before signing.
Add the cancellation cost of recurring commitments to an exit fund.

quote.text: Before you commit to anything, price out exactly what it costs to undo it. Not just what it costs to start it.
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

tactics.name: Use CATO to decide what to delegate
steps: List tasks that should be cut entirely.
Automate tasks that remain, such as inbox management.
Delegate tasks that software cannot handle adequately.
Outsource a whole job when it no longer needs to report back for each action.

quote.text: What does this mean? Cut, automate, delegate, outsource.
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

tactics.name: Start at the bottom of the assistant ladder
steps: Write down three recurring tasks that do not require the founder specifically.
Begin with a virtual assistant for inbox, scheduling, and repetitive work.
Move to an assistant for filtering daily tasks as needs grow.
Use a chief of staff only when the role can run projects and make decisions end to end.

quote.text: Before the end of the day, write down the three tasks, eating your week that don't require you specifically using Keto.
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

tactics.name: Choose skills by how often they will be reused
steps: Estimate how many times a skill will recur in your work.
Prioritize repeatable skills such as sales, negotiation, and operations.
Invest more in skills you expect to use repeatedly.

quote.text: How many times if you acquire this skill, will you repeat its use?
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

tactics.name: Use meal preparation to buy back cooking time
steps: Compare the weekly cost of prepared meals with the time spent cooking.
If using a chef, batch several days of food in one visit.
Choose the option only if its cost fits your own buyback rate.

quote.text: For some people, this is a no brainer. Others, the buyback rate doesn't work out. Do the math, see what works for you.
quote.speaker: Codie Sanchez

evidence_quality.rationale: This is a solo advice video with personal examples, broad claims attributed to unnamed studies, and limited supporting detail. It is not a focused operator interview about one business, and several numerical claims cannot be checked from the transcript alone.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Codie Sanchez promotes a free owner event and gives an Eight Sleep discount link, while saying she may no longer earn money from that link.
